description: Phase 7 direct-distribution validation for n=3 Grover-Rudolph laws supporting quantity-of-interest functionals. This campaign intentionally avoids Runtime DD/twirling because Phase 5 showed that mitigation is not uniformly beneficial for these short circuits.
rationale: Phase 6 identified gr_sin2_half_n3 raw and gr_sin2_n3 raw/mitigated as the most reliable sources of publishable or usable quantity-of-interest functionals.
For gr_sin2_half_n3 the raw run had better Hellinger/classical fidelity and stronger QoI coverage than the mitigated repeat.
For gr_sin2_n3 mitigation improved selected simple functionals but worsened TVD and sin_pi_x; a higher-shot raw repeat is the cleanest control.
The campaign measures distributions only. It does not run Grover amplification or QAE.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x / 2), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Higher-shot validation of direct functionals I_p(f) for the monotone n=3 profile.

selected_cases.label: sin2(pi x), 8 midpoint cells
selected_cases.purpose: Higher-shot raw control for the symmetric n=3 profile, especially call_x_minus_half and sin_pi_x.

stopping_rules: Do not use this campaign to infer amplified-QAE viability.
If either distribution has TVD above 0.04, keep the corresponding case as diagnostic only.
If QoI estimates preserve errors below 0.01 for at least four of five targets, keep the case in the publication set.
